title: 第13章 什么？我竟然比不上这个NPC（求追读！）
slug: 我在致郁番里画热血番
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

当宋瑶瑶看到第一话，他竟然正儿八经地取了个名字时，嘴里的水都差点喷出来。

【第一话标题：神峰奇遇！】

“这NPC还挺逗！”

她一边往下看，一边嘀咕。

明明是这么粗劣的A4纸手绘画的，但是这一次的线条显然不是上次那样完全的潦草，而是认真了一些。

第一话的内容很简单。

一个山上采药的老爷爷为了救一只鸟，掉下了山崖，来到了一座神奇的山洞里，并且救了一只穿山甲。

穿山甲又跟老爷爷说，这地方有一个蛇精和蝎子精，被压在葫芦山下，已经九千九百九十九年。

只要再过一年，它们就能化成灰烬。

可他不小心把山钻破了。

如今这两个妖怪也跑了。

宋瑶瑶看到这里无语了一下。

“你知道这里镇压了两个妖怪你还瞎钻？”

“晚一年再钻不就大结局了吗？”

她继续往底下看。

这充满BUG的剧情！

这熟悉的画风！

一下让她乐出了声。

老爷爷千辛万苦拿回来了葫芦籽，不往泥土里种，就往石头里丢。

好在这是神仙葫芦籽，还是顽强地冲破泥土，仅一秒就长成了一根长长的藤。

长藤上，结出了七个葫芦！

葫芦还会动！

它会叫：“爷爷！爷爷！”

七个葫芦让爷爷在家里别出来，它们有办法对付妖怪，爷爷看到妖怪想放火烧藤，便想出来保护葫芦藤，结果被妖怪抓走了！

明明嘴上吐槽着的宋瑶瑶，看到这里时，忍不住着急：“让别出来，还非要出来！这下好了！被抓走了吧！”

原本在藤上的七个葫芦，此时因为爷爷被抓走了，终于着急了。

急得脸上都出了表情包。

“爷爷！”

“爷爷！”

“噗……”

宋瑶瑶原本在喝水，在见到葫芦脸上这表情包的时候，水都差点喷出来。

虽然依旧是简单的三幕式剧情，但是好歹这个NPC竟然会开始设计人物关系了！

这简直是剧情的一大进步！

养成系！

这妥妥养成系啊！

“葫芦娃！！”

“既然是娃！那当然得可爱！讨喜！画风优美！要是如仙鹤般充满灵气的小仙童！”

田小西在看到葫芦娃的封面出来的时候，差点两眼一黑。

潦草至极的封面！

content_en:
Page (1/3)

When Song Yaoyao read the first episode and he actually picked a name seriously, the water in her mouth almost spurted out.

[Title of Chapter 1: Adventure at the Divine Peak!】

"This NPC is quite funny!"

She muttered as she looked down.

It was obviously hand-drawn on such crude A4 paper, but the lines this time were obviously not as completely scrawled as last time, but more serious.

The content of the first episode is very simple.

An old man collecting herbs on the mountain fell off a cliff in order to save a bird. He came to a magical cave and saved a pangolin.

The pangolin told the old man that there is a snake spirit and a scorpion spirit here, and they have been trapped under Calabash Mountain for nine thousand nine hundred and ninety-nine years.

Just one more year and they will turn into ashes.

But he accidentally drilled through the mountain.

Now these two monsters have also escaped.

Song Yaoyao was speechless when she saw this.

"You know there are two monsters suppressed here and you still do it blindly?"

"Wouldn't it be the end if we waited a year later?"

She continued to look down.

This plot is full of bugs!

This familiar style of painting!

It made her laugh out loud.

The old man worked hard to get back the gourd seeds. If he didn't plant them in the soil, he would throw them into stones.

Fortunately, these were fairy gourd seeds. They still broke through the soil tenaciously and grew into a long vine in just one second.

Seven gourds grew on the long vine!

The gourd can still move!

It will cry: "Grandpa! Grandpa!"

The seven gourds told Grandpa to stay at home. They have ways to deal with monsters. Grandpa saw that the monster wanted to set fire to the vines, so he wanted to protect the gourd vines, but was captured by the monster!

Song Yaoyao, who was obviously complaining, couldn't help but be anxious when she saw this: "Let me come out, but you still have to come out! It's okay now! You have been captured!"

The seven gourds that were originally on the vine were finally anxious because their grandfather was taken away.

He was so anxious that expressions appeared on his face.

"Grandpa!"

"Grandpa!"

"Pfft..."

Song Yaoyao was drinking water, but when she saw the expression on Hu Lu's face, she almost spit out the water.

Although it is still a simple three-act plot, at least this NPC can start to design character relationships!

This is simply a great improvement in the plot!

Nurture system!

This is a well-established system!

"Calabash baby!!"

"Since it's a baby! Of course it has to be cute! Likeable! Beautifully painted! If it's a little fairy child full of aura like a crane!"

Tian Xiaoxi almost blacked out when she saw the cover of Calabash Baby.

The cover is extremely sloppy!
